terms.gloss: strictly speaking, properly, in the proper sense
evidence: Cic. Phil. 2.77: magis propriē nihil possum dīcere (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Off. 3.13: quod propriē vērēque dīcitur (Lewis & Short)

sources: Lewis & Short: Lewis & Short: proprius (propriē)
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
